indexabilityStagesExplained.A: Technically indexable: Prerendered HTML valid, self-canonical present, no noindex directives, allowed by robots.txt
indexabilityStagesExplained.B: Crawlable in production: Live production host returns HTTP 200, clean headers, no unhandled redirects
indexabilityStagesExplained.C: Discovered by Google: Present in submitted sitemap.xml and internal link graphs
indexabilityStagesExplained.D: Crawled by Google: Googlebot actively requests and renders the page (requires GSC / log data)
indexabilityStagesExplained.E: Indexed by Google: Selected and stored in Google Search index (requires Google Search Console Inspection)
